entities.summary: Schmalkaldic League, a political institution in Germany during The Protestant Reformation (1530–1555). Grew from Diet of Worms – Luther refuses to recant and Luther's 95 Theses & Early Reformation. Led to the emergence of Peace of Augsburg.
